research_questions.guardrail: The same diagnosis can be mild, episodic, severe, progressive, stable or profoundly disabling in different people.

research_questions.question: Which factors predict improvement, persistence or worsening in finances after Guillain-Barré syndrome during one to three years?
research_questions.why_it_matters: This question examines finances without assuming a uniform response to Guillain-Barré syndrome.
research_questions.guardrail: Association is not proof of individual causation.

guardrails: Improvement can coexist with permanent disability or changed roles.
Symptoms can fluctuate while disease status appears stable.
Anniversaries, tests, court dates, benefit reviews, moves and relationship changes can reactivate distress.
Adaptation does not prove the original harm was minor.
